skill.summary: AI-powered diagram creation, editing, and format conversion. Generate flowcharts, sequence diagrams, ER diagrams, architecture diagrams and more in Mermaid,...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Diagram Generator.

- AI-powered creation, editing, and format conversion for diagrams using natural language.
- Supports multiple diagram types: flowchart, sequence, ER, class, state, mindmap, architecture, network, gantt, pie, git, and C4.
- Outputs in Mermaid, draw.io, PlantUML, and Graphviz formats.
- Includes local and AI-assisted commands for generating, editing, converting, explaining, and previewing diagrams.
- Requires EvoLink API key for AI functionality; local previews and templates work offline.
